why: G18e unit 1 (D-423) -- LOVE MODE, FEEDING AND BREEDING. `EL.aiCtx`'s `onBreed` did nothing and its `isTempting` always refused, so `Ai.BreedGoal` and `Ai.TemptGoal` had been wired to nothing since D-383 and nothing could tell. This drives the real module, the real `EntityList` tick and the real ctx, and asserts the four KINDS of isFood survive the pack step -- `none` (vanilla forbids it) is a different fact from `predicate` (not a list).
